note: Complete nested shape of every exported report type, extracted statically from source. No execution involved; this is the authoritative response schema.

fields.name: OutDir
fields.doc: OutDir receives admitted CBA replays.

fields.name: RejectDir
fields.doc: RejectDir receives everything else.

fields.name: Max
fields.doc: Max is a hard ceiling on fetches this run.

fields.name: Delay
fields.doc: Delay between requests (0 = DefaultArchiveDelay).

fields.name: Progress
fields.doc: Progress is called after each item.

cba.ArchiveRecord.name: ArchiveRecord
cba.ArchiveRecord.doc: ArchiveRecord is the durable outcome for one queue item.

fields.name: MinGames
fields.doc: MinGames drops players too thin to score (default 3).

fields.name: Names
fields.doc: Names maps profile id -> display name.

fields.name: Anchors
fields.doc: Anchors / Stackers override the package defaults when non-nil.

cba.Corpus.name: Corpus
cba.Corpus.doc: Corpus is the durable store behind the CBA ladder: one GameRecord per ingested replay, persisted as JSONL.

cba.GameRecord.name: GameRecord
cba.GameRecord.doc: GameRecord is one ingested replay: the identity we matched it by, plus the extractor's per-player performance rows verbatim.

fields.name: Force
fields.doc: Force re-extracts games already present instead of skipping them.

fields.name: Limit
fields.doc: Limit caps how many NEW games are ingested this run (0 = no cap).

fields.name: Workers
fields.doc: Workers sets extraction concurrency.

fields.name: Progress
fields.doc: Progress, if set, is called per replay with the outcome.

cba.IngestResult.name: IngestResult
cba.IngestResult.doc: IngestResult reports what a run did.

fields.name: Workers
fields.doc: Workers records the concurrency actually used.

cba.PlayerAxes.name: PlayerAxes
cba.PlayerAxes.doc: PlayerAxes is one player's multi-axis profile.

fields.name: CombatCivAdjusted
fields.doc: CombatCivAdjusted counts how many combat samples had a trusted civ baseline applied.

cba.QueueItem.name: QueueItem
cba.QueueItem.doc: QueueItem is one match to archive.

fields.name: Note
fields.doc: Note is free-text provenance from discovery (e.g.

cba.Registry.name: Registry
cba.Registry.doc: Registry is the admission decision for a whole replay tree.

cba.RegistryPlayer.name: RegistryPlayer
cba.RegistryPlayer.doc: RegistryPlayer is one seat in a classified game.

cba.ScenarioIdentity.name: ScenarioIdentity
cba.ScenarioIdentity.doc: ScenarioIdentity is why a replay was admitted to, or rejected from, the ladder.

fields.name: ActivePlayers
fields.doc: ActivePlayers identifies the players allowed to interact with the store.

fields.name: Generation
fields.doc: Generation counts how many times this kit has been packed and repacked.

main.CatalogEntry.name: CatalogEntry
main.CatalogEntry.doc: CatalogEntry mirrors one row of the CLI's declared command catalog.

fields.name: Limit
fields.doc: Limit caps emitted event rows (0 = all).

fields.name: Tail
fields.doc: Tail filters events/streams to a single tail_u32 value when >= 0.

fields.name: Limit
fields.doc: Limit caps emitted samples per player (0 = all).

fields.name: ChangesOnly
fields.doc: ChangesOnly emits only samples where one of the decoded checksum words changed from that player's previous sample.

fields.name: Window
fields.doc: Window is the number of checksum samples before and after a feedback moment to include.

fields.name: Limit
fields.doc: Limit caps emitted event rows (0 = all).

fields.name: ChecksumsOnly
fields.doc: ChecksumsOnly emits only checksum-carrying syncs as rows.

fields.name: RawWords
fields.doc: RawWords emits one row per DE checksum sample and player slot with all 11 words.

replay.XSTelemetryOptions.name: XSTelemetryOptions
replay.XSTelemetryOptions.doc: XSTelemetryOptions selects the authored carrier bases used by a probe.

scenario.CoverageCorpusReport.name: CoverageCorpusReport
scenario.CoverageCorpusReport.doc: CoverageCorpusReport summarizes dark-byte spans without retaining parsed scenarios.

scenario.CoverageReport.name: CoverageReport
scenario.CoverageReport.doc: CoverageReport accounts for parsed scenario bytes without treating successful structural parsing as semantic understanding.

scenario.DarkSpan.name: DarkSpan
scenario.DarkSpan.doc: DarkSpan identifies the parser field responsible for a conservative dark byte range.

scenario.DataHeaderLayout.name: DataHeaderLayout
scenario.DataHeaderLayout.doc: DataHeaderLayout is the owned player/header slice.

scenario.FieldQueryResult.name: FieldQueryResult
scenario.FieldQueryResult.doc: FieldQueryResult is one stable-path lookup result for scen field.

scenario.ImportTriggersOptions.name: ImportTriggersOptions
scenario.ImportTriggersOptions.doc: ImportTriggersOptions controls a raw-preserving trigger import.

scenario.Layout.name: Layout
scenario.Layout.doc: Layout is Kit's owned description of byte facts.

scenario.LayoutDocument.name: LayoutDocument
scenario.LayoutDocument.doc: LayoutDocument is the migration seam between the three layers: byte preservation, semantic values, and raw-preserving variable sections.

fields.name: DatPath
fields.doc: DatPath enables DAT-backed unit availability checks.

fields.name: Generated
fields.doc: Generated marks output produced by Kit.

scenario.OpaqueSpan.name: OpaqueSpan
scenario.OpaqueSpan.doc: OpaqueSpan identifies bytes that the semantic model does not own.

fields.name: StopBeforeSection
fields.doc: StopBeforeSection, when set, halts body parsing when the named section is reached and returns the sections parsed so far.

scenario.PlayerReference.name: PlayerReference
scenario.PlayerReference.doc: PlayerReference keeps the editor-facing slot separate from the raw array index.

scenario.PreservedDocument.name: PreservedDocument
scenario.PreservedDocument.doc: PreservedDocument is the lossless carrier shared by the codecs.

scenario.RawTriggerSection.name: RawTriggerSection
scenario.RawTriggerSection.doc: RawTriggerSection is the preservation-first trigger codec.

scenario.RepeatRule.name: RepeatRule
scenario.RepeatRule.doc: RepeatRule is Kit-owned codec logic for data-dependent field counts.

scenario.ScenarioHeader.name: ScenarioHeader
scenario.ScenarioHeader.doc: ScenarioHeader is the first-slice typed view of the uncompressed file header.

fields.name: StartingAge
fields.doc: StartingAge applies the editor's per-player starting-age field to all playable slots.

scenario.SecondaryGameModesInfo.name: SecondaryGameModesInfo
scenario.SecondaryGameModesInfo.doc: SecondaryGameModesInfo is the editor's Map.secondary_game_modes bitfield.

scenario.SemanticDocument.name: SemanticDocument
scenario.SemanticDocument.doc: SemanticDocument is the editor-facing layer over the byte layout.

scenario.StructureFieldDiff.name: StructureFieldDiff
scenario.StructureFieldDiff.doc: StructureFieldDiff is a path-aligned field change.

scenario.TriggerConditionDump.name: TriggerConditionDump
scenario.TriggerConditionDump.doc: TriggerConditionDump is a full per-trigger view including decoded conditions, which TriggerInfo summarizes away.

xs.ParseCheckReport.name: ParseCheckReport
xs.ParseCheckReport.doc: ParseCheckReport records the result of an optional external XS parser.

xs.SourceFinding.name: SourceFinding
xs.SourceFinding.doc: SourceFinding is a conservative source check, not an XS compiler verdict.

xs.SourceLintOptions.name: SourceLintOptions
xs.SourceLintOptions.doc: SourceLintOptions controls checks that need more context than the historical source-only lint.
